name: North Inlet–Tonahutu Creek Loop (Continental Divide Loop)
notes: Classic Grand Lake-area loop over the Continental Divide between North Inlet and Tonahutu. NPS trip-planning records describe North Inlet Junction, North Inlet Falls, Porcupine, Haynach, Green Mountain and Tonahutu Meadows as distinct camping choices.

name: Bear Lake–Fern Lake / Odessa Loop
notes: Short classic high-country loop with an overnight option at Fern or Odessa. Glacier Gorge is included because the Bear Lake trail network can be routed through that corridor; select only camps legal for the chosen itinerary.

name: Wild Basin Lakes Loop
notes: Wild Basin overnight corridor connecting North St. Vrain, Ouzel and Thunder Lake areas. The route is commonly done as an out-and-back or short loop depending on snow and trail conditions.

name: Lawn Lake / Mummy Range Loop
notes: Northern RMNP high-country loop variation over Lawn Lake and Mummy Pass. It is a strenuous cross-country-sensitive route; use the park's current site-details table and snow-free dates when selecting an itinerary.
